name: Jaflong
summary: A border town on the Dawki river with stone collection, hills of Meghalaya in view, tea gardens and the Khasi village life.
season_note: Winter has clear views and calm water. Monsoon brings strong flow and spectacular waterfalls but can flood the road.

reach.how: Bus or train Dhaka to Sylhet, then car or bus to Jaflong (about 1.5 hrs)
reach.note: Often combined with Ratargul or Bichanakandi.

local.note: Day hire often covers several sites.

local.mode: Local bus or CNG from Sylhet

attractions.name: Piyain river and stone beds
attractions.what: Wide river bed with piles of stones, boats and views of Meghalaya hills.
attractions.tip: Beware slippery rocks and strong current in rainy season.

attractions.name: Jaflong tea estate
attractions.what: Green tea slopes along the road with border hills.

attractions.name: Khasi village (Pan Punji)
attractions.what: A Khasi village known for betel leaf cultivation and tidy hillside homes.
attractions.tip: Ask before taking photos of people.

attractions.name: Boat ride on the Dawki river
attractions.what: Hired boat to see stone workers and views of the border hills.
attractions.tip: Do not cross or touch the border line.

attractions.name: Zero Point and border view
attractions.what: Viewpoint of the border area; bring identity papers.

budget.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

mid.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

luxury.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

rules: Do not collect stones from the river.
